decision: nb36 production posterior ACCEPTED with a documented exception; the acceptance criterion and stage_accept are NOT amended
exception: 4 of 52 cells on the nb35 inlet grid miss the class-accuracy criterion (accuracy >= nb35 oracle - 0.10): Sc2 nominal, Sc2 Tci-0.5 K, Sc2 Tci+0.5 K, Sc4 Tci+0.5 K (class accuracy only; beta 90% coverage 0.94-0.98 in those cells; calibration passes)
reason: the shortfall is the real accuracy cost of eps = 0.1 K inlet sensors near the class threshold, not noise: the scenarios concerned have beta = 0.85, 0.05 below the 0.90 class threshold, and the cause is posterior width (beta sd ~0.045 at eps = 0.1 K against 0.017 for the oracle and ~0.03 at eps = 0.05 K); on ~1,000 fresh windows per cell the nb36 ensemble is 0.07-0.13 below the oracle in class accuracy at Sc2 and 0.07 at Sc4 (Sc2 nominal 0.877 vs oracle 0.987; Tci-0.5 0.921 vs 0.994; Tci+0.5 0.857 vs 0.985; Sc4 Tci+0.5 0.803 vs 0.877), eps = 0.05 K recovers most of it (0.951, 0.976, 0.935, 0.846)
